title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own

paragraphs.en: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta’s Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor’s cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person’s accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta’s public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone’s screen and the computer’s. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.
paragraphs.zh: 2011 年的助手只会回答和等待，而 2023 年的智能体则会执行任务后停止。2026 年 9 月，Meta 的 Muse 推出了一款面向单个人的智能体，该智能体拥有账户、设备、记忆以及一段持续进行、最终在某个国家供应商的云环境中关闭的对话。这样的智能体预计能够操作用户的账户和设备，跨周记住相关信息，在必要时主动发言，并对自己的行为负责。它是一种软件，而非模型，且迄今为止尚无开源的对应版本。本报告通过五个问题和三个阶段来定义个人智能体。报告依据 Meta 的公开记录及其生产提示词副本，解析了 Muse 的构建过程，并对每一项陈述标注了其来源。随后，报告介绍了 nanoMuse——一款基于 GPL-3.0 协议的开源对应产品：它为个人拥有的每一台设备部署一个智能体，用户可以直接操作手机和计算机的屏幕。这些设备通过任何人都可运行的中继器共享一段对话；所有操作均需经过“哨兵”（Sentinel）处理，记忆以用户可读的文件形式存储，而模型则由用户自行选择。报告还提供了其规模与成本的估算数据。此外，报告还规划了未来的路线图，包括开放化、具备来源追溯的记忆机制、用于直接操作的评估套件，以及面向这些操作的开源模型。

paragraphs.en: A personal agent is a program that acts for one person on their accounts, their devices and their files. It works for weeks, partly while they are away, and it answers to them afterwards for what it did, with a log, a ledger and a list of the permissions it holds. Who runs that program, where, and under whose eyes is not a detail of deployment. It is the product.
paragraphs.zh: 个人智能体是一种程序，它代表某个人在其账户、设备和文件上执行操作。它会持续数周运行，部分时间是在用户不在时工作，之后会向用户汇报其执行的操作，并提供日志、账本以及其所持权限的列表。谁在运行该程序、运行地点以及处于谁的监督之下，这些都不属于部署的细节问题。它本身就是最终产物。

paragraphs.en: In September 2026 Meta released Muse, and within three weeks OpenAI, Manus and a new company called Today released agents of the same kind [ 21 , 29 , 19 , 37 ] . Muse showed the field what the product is. It is one agent with a name and one long conversation, with memory the person can read, messages it sends first, a wallet behind an approval, and a safety architecture written up in public [ 36 ] . It also runs in one Linux VM per person in Meta’s cloud and is sold in the United States only. Nothing of it is open except a small SDK, published on October 2, for the gadgets it can talk to [ 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 2026年9月，Meta发布了Muse，三周之内，OpenAI、Manus以及一家名为Today的新公司也发布了同类型的智能体 [ 21 , 29 , 19 , 37 ] 。Muse向该领域展示了这种产品的形态：它由一个带有名称的智能体和一次长时间的对话组成；对话内容包含用户可读的记忆、智能体首先发送的消息、一个需经批准才能使用的钱包，以及一份公开编写的安全架构说明 [ 36 ]。此外，它在Meta的云端为每位用户运行于一个独立的Linux虚拟机中，且仅在美国销售。除了10月2日发布的、用于与其可交互的设备通信的小型SDK外，其余部分均非开源 [ 20 ]。

paragraphs.en: We think the second half of that description is the wrong shape for the first half. An agent that holds a person’s life should be inspectable by that person or by anyone they trust. It should run on the hardware they already own where that is possible, and on a server they chose where it is not. The one piece that has to be shared, the meeting point of their devices, should be code anyone can read and run. This is not an argument against Muse. It is an argument that the open counterpart has to exist, as a complete thing a person can run. nanoMuse is our attempt at that counterpart, and Fig. 1 is the shape of it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，上述描述的后半部分与前半部分所描述的内容并不匹配。一个掌控着个人生活的智能体，应当允许该个人或任何其信任的人进行审查。在可能的情况下，它应运行在用户已有的硬件上；而在无法实现时，则应运行在用户自行选择的服务器上。唯一需要共享的部分——即用户设备之间的交汇点——应当是任何人都可以阅读和运行的代码。这并不是对 Muse 的否定，而是主张必须存在一个完全开放、可供个人完整运行的对应版本。nanoMuse 正是我们尝试构建这一对应版本的成果，而图 1 则展示了其形态。

paragraphs.en: (1) A definition of the personal agent opens the report, with the history from the assistants of 2011 to the agents of September 2026 ( Sec. 2 ). (2) A reading of how Muse is built follows, from Meta’s public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source ( Sec. 3 ). (3) A statement of what a personal agent should be comes as five questions and three horizons ( Sec. 4 ). (4) nanoMuse, an open personal agent on every device a person owns, is presented with hands on the phone’s screen and the computer’s, a Sentinel over every action, memory as files, and its size and cost in numbers ( Sec. 5 ). (5) A roadmap of the open work closes the report, with what we would not yet trust it with ( Secs. 6 and 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: （1）报告开篇对个人智能体进行了定义，并追溯了从2011年的助手到2026年9月的智能体的发展历程（第2节）。（2）接下来介绍了Muse的构建方式，内容基于Meta的公开记录及其生产提示词副本，每个陈述均标注了其来源（第3节）。（3）报告随后阐述了个人智能体应有的形态，通过五个问题和三个未来展望进行了说明（第4节）。（4）nanoMuse是一款开放的个人智能体，可部署在用户拥有的每一台设备上。报告通过展示其操作手机和电脑屏幕的手部动作、作为“哨兵”监控每一项操作、以文件形式存储记忆，以及用具体数字呈现其规模与成本，对其进行了介绍（第5节）。（5）最后，报告通过一份开放项目的路线图收尾，并说明了目前尚无法完全信任该智能体的领域（第6节和第7节）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 is the short history. Siri, Alexa and Google Assistant answered a question and waited for the next. ChatGPT could be told to do things, and within months people had it doing them: AutoGPT let the loop run unattended [ 34 ] , Open Interpreter let a model write and run code on the user’s own computer [ 17 ] . The screen became a tool next: CogAgent trained a vision-language model to read one [ 7 ] , AppAgent and Mobile-Agent drove a phone from a PC through its screenshots [ 45 , 38 ] , Anthropic’s computer use drove a desktop the same way [ 1 ] , Zhipu’s AutoGLM drove a phone through its accessibility tree [ 16 ] , and MCP gave agents one standard for tools [ 2 ] . Open models that operate a screen followed, OS-Atlas, Aguvis and UI-TARS [ 41 , 43 , 32 ] , then OpenCUA and Mobile-Agent-v3’s GUI-Owl [ 39 , 44 ] , measured on live environments: Mind2Web and WebArena for the web [ 6 , 47 ] , OSWorld for the desktop [ 42 ] , AndroidWorld for the phone [ 33 ] ; the phone side of this history is surveyed in [ 11 ] . Then the vendors moved the agent into their own clouds: Operator [ 28 ] and ChatGPT agent [ 27 ] were hosted browsers the user watched, Manus a cloud computer per task [ 18 ] . Every one of these acts for a task; none belongs to a person. Two open projects crossed that line from the other side: Hermes Agent and OpenClaw run on a computer or server of the person’s own, remember across sessions, and are reached through the chat apps the person already uses [ 26 , 30 ] ; neither has a screen. OpenMinis (June 2026) is the opposite construction: a complete agent inside an Android app, GPL, no server [ 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 图2展示了这一简短的历史。Siri、Alexa和Google Assistant会回答问题，然后等待下一个问题。而ChatGPT则可以被赋予执行任务的能力，并在数月内被广泛用于完成各种任务：AutoGPT让这一循环过程无需人工干预即可持续运行 [34]，Open Interpreter则让模型能够直接在用户的个人计算机上编写并运行代码 [17]。接下来，屏幕本身也变成了一种工具：CogAgent训练了一个视觉语言模型来读取屏幕内容 [7]；AppAgent和Mobile-Agent通过截屏的方式，在个人计算机上操控手机 [45, 38]；Anthropic的计算机使用方案以类似方式操控桌面环境 [1]；Zhipu的AutoGLM则通过手机的无障碍树结构来操控手机 [16]；而MCP则为智能体提供了一套统一的标准化工具接口 [2]。随后，能够操作屏幕的开放模型相继出现，包括OS-Atlas、Aguvis和UI-TARS [41, 43, 32]，以及OpenCUA和Mobile-Agent-v3的GUI-Owl [39, 44]，这些模型均在真实环境中进行了测试：Mind2Web和WebArena用于网页环境 [6, 47]，OSWorld用于桌面环境 [42]，AndroidWorld则用于手机环境 [33]；这一历史中涉及手机的部分在文献[11]中有详细综述。之后，各大厂商将智能体迁移至自己的云端：Operator [28]和ChatGPT智能体 [27] 是以用户可观看的浏览器形式托管的，而Manus则为每项任务提供独立的云计算机服务 [18]。这些系统都是为特定任务而设计的，没有一个真正属于某个个人。有两个开源项目则从另一端跨越了这一界限：Hermes Agent和OpenClaw运行在用户自己的计算机或服务器上，能够跨会话保留状态，并通过用户已有的聊天应用进行访问 [26, 30]；但两者都没有屏幕。OpenMinis（2026年6月）则是相反的设计：一个完整的智能体被集成到Android应用中，采用GPL许可，且无需服务器 [31]。

paragraphs.en: The lower half of Fig. 2 expands five weeks, and Tab. 1 lists what arrived in them. Muse (September 8) is the first product to assemble the pieces for one person and to say so in its first sentence [ 21 ] . Today (September 15) is a personal agent from a new company, with memory, proactive follow-up and a cloud computer [ 37 , 8 ] . The same day CopilotKit published OpenMuse, open source and in Muse’s shape: a server with a persistent browser, the apps as windows onto it [ 4 ] . Manus Cue (September 28) gives each agent its own e-mail address, phone number, wallet and computer [ 19 ] ; OpenAI’s dots (September 29) are “always-on agents” with a cloud computer each [ 29 ] . On October 2 Meta opened one edge of Muse: a gadget SDK under the Apache licence, so that a device a person builds can pair with their Muse [ 20 ] ; the agent, the service and the model stay closed. Four companies, five weeks, one architecture: a computer per person in the vendor’s cloud, thin clients on the person’s devices, a model the vendor trains.
paragraphs.zh: 图2的下半部分展示了五周的时间跨度，表1则列出了这期间推出的产品。Muse（9月8日）是首款为个人整合各项组件，并在首句中明确说明这一点的产品 [ 21 ]。Today（9月15日）是一家新公司推出的个人智能体，具备记忆功能、主动跟进能力以及一台云计算机 [ 37 , 8 ]。同一天，CopilotKit发布了OpenMuse：一个开源且采用Muse形态的项目，即一台带有持久化浏览器的服务器，各类应用则作为访问该服务器的窗口 [ 4 ]。Manus Cue（9月28日）为每个智能体分配了专属的电子邮件地址、电话号码、钱包和计算机 [ 19]；而OpenAI的dots（9月29日）则是“始终在线的智能体”，每个都配备一台云计算机 [ 29]。10月2日，Meta开放了Muse的一个边缘接口：一个基于Apache许可证的设备SDK，使得个人自行构建的设备能够与他们的Muse配对 [ 20]；但智能体、服务和模型本身仍保持封闭。四家公司、五周时间、一种架构：供应商的云端为每个人提供一台计算机，用户的设备上运行轻量客户端，而模型则由供应商进行训练。

paragraphs.en: a Android only; iOS lets no app operate another, so no agent has a phone screen there. b Through the Muse macOS app, as a dimmed live stage with a stop control. c Today’s own description; not verified by us. d An accessibility executor; the screenshot loop of Sec. 5 is nanoMuse’s. e OpenMuse’s own description; graphical desktops are listed as future work. f The gadget SDK of October 2, 2026 is Apache-2.0; the agent, the service and the model are not open [ 20 ] .
paragraphs.zh: a 仅限 Android；iOS 不允许任何应用程序操作另一款应用，因此没有智能体能够在此访问手机屏幕。b 通过 Muse macOS 应用程序实现，表现为一个带有停止控制的暗化实时舞台。c 今日提供的官方描述；未经我们验证。d 一个无障碍执行器；第 5 节中的截图循环来自 nanoMuse。e OpenMuse 的官方描述；图形桌面被列为未来工作。f 2026 年 10 月 2 日的设备 SDK 采用 Apache-2.0 许可；智能体、服务和模型并非开源 [ 20 ]。

paragraphs.en: Models learned to call tools and to read screens, which made “act” possible; memory and background execution made “for one person” possible. And the phone is where the person’s life is, which makes “where it runs” the question that decides the rest: the cloud computers above reach anything with an API or a web page and nothing else, and many of the apps a person uses every day, from banking to government services, have neither. That gap is what nanoMuse’s hands are for.
paragraphs.zh: 模型学会了调用工具和读取屏幕，这使得“行动”成为可能；而记忆和后台执行则让“为个人服务”成为可能。手机正是承载个人生活的重要载体，因此“运行环境”这一问题便决定了其余一切：云端计算机只能通过 API 或网页访问任何内容，除此之外别无他法，而人们日常使用的许多应用程序——从银行服务到政府服务——恰恰不具备这两者。填补这一空白，正是 nanoMuse 双手存在的意义所在。

paragraphs.en: Muse is described by Meta in three public documents, the launch announcement [ 21 ] , an essay on the safety architecture by the engineer who led it [ 36 ] and a design essay by the product leads [ 35 ] , with a help-centre page on privacy as a fourth [ 22 ] . We have also read a copy of Muse’s production system prompt, October 2026. We do not reproduce it and quote at most a few words at a time; a prompt says what the agent is told, which is close to what the agent is but not the same thing. Each statement below carries its source: documented (said by Meta in public), prompt (read in that copy), observed (seen in the shipped clients) or inferred (our reading of the rest). Figure 3 draws the result.
paragraphs.zh: Meta 在三份公开文件中对 Muse 进行了描述：发布声明 [21]、负责领导该项目的工程师撰写的关于安全架构的文章 [36]，以及产品负责人撰写的设计文章 [35]；此外，隐私相关的帮助中心页面是第四份材料 [22]。我们还阅读了 Muse 生产系统提示词的一份副本（2026 年 10 月版本）。我们未完整复现该提示词，每次最多仅引用几个词；提示词说明了智能体被告知的内容，这与智能体本身的状态相近，但并非完全相同。以下每一项陈述都标注了其来源：文档记录（Meta 在公开信息中所言）、提示词（从该副本中读得）、观察结果（在已发布的客户端中见到）或推断（我们对其余内容的解读）。图 3 展示了这一分析结果。

paragraphs.en: Observed. Muse did not win on a benchmark; it won on a shape. Its designers write that the first line of its instructions is about making the person’s life better [ 35 ] . Ten decisions, visible on one phone screen, carry it: one agent with a name and a face; one long conversation rather than sessions; a status line under the face; a chip for every tool call with an activity log behind it; cards where words are not enough (a scoped approval, a secure form the model never sees, a single-use card at checkout); memory as files the person can open and edit; a high bar for writing first that the person can move; five rooms, Chat, Feed, Ideas, Goals and a Library that holds the artifacts; the computer shown as a dimmed live stage with a stop control; and the agent’s steps shown by default. Together they make a background agent legible, which is what lets a person leave it running.
paragraphs.zh: 观察结果。Muse 并未在基准测试中获胜，而是在一种形态上取得了成功。其设计者写道，其指令的第一行旨在改善用户的生活 [35]。十个决定清晰地呈现在一个手机屏幕上：一个带有姓名和面孔的智能体；一次长时间的对话而非分段的会话；面孔下方的状态栏；每次工具调用时显示一个芯片，并附有活动日志；文字难以充分表达时的卡片（如范围限定的批准、模型永远无法看到的加密表单、结账时使用的单次使用卡）；以文件形式存在的记忆，用户可以打开和编辑；用户可调整的高写作标准；五个房间：聊天、动态、创意、目标以及存放各种成果物的图书馆；计算机被呈现为一个调暗的实时舞台，并配有停止控制按钮；此外，智能体的每一步操作也会默认显示。这些元素共同使背景智能体变得清晰易懂，而这正是用户愿意让它持续运行的原因。

paragraphs.en: Prompt. The prompt opens with a persona, not with a task. The agent has a name, a voice and an avatar, and a list of values it is to hold and may grow into; it works for one person and for no one else, Meta included; its authority comes from that person’s requests and from nothing it reads along the way. Discretion is a whole section: every output is a surface its intimate access can leak through, so it uses the minimum a task needs and leaves the rest unsaid. The person’s authority over their own household, devices and children’s care is stated as unconditional. There is a writing-style section, with a rule against em dashes, and a short list of hard stops: no sexual content involving minors under any framing, no help with biological or chemical weapons, no identifying people from their faces, no inferring sensitive attributes. Inferred. The model named in the copy is a numbered release of Meta’s Muse Spark family, which documented Meta describes as trained for tool calling, long trajectories and an awareness of prompt injection [ 36 ] ; its size and training data are unknown .
paragraphs.zh: 提示。该提示以角色设定开头，而非任务说明。智能体拥有姓名、语气和虚拟形象，以及一套需要秉持并可能逐步发展的价值观；它只为一个人工作，不为任何人其他服务，包括 Meta 在内；其权威源于那个人的请求，而非途中读到的任何内容。“审慎”是一个独立部分：每一次输出都可能成为其私密信息泄露的渠道，因此它仅使用完成任务所需的最小信息量，其余则不予言明。该智能体对其主人家庭、设备及子女照料的无条件权威被明确列出。提示中还包括一个写作风格部分，规定禁止使用破折号，并列出若干严格禁止事项：在任何情境下均不得涉及未成年人的性内容，不得协助制造生物或化学武器，不得通过面部识别身份，也不得推断敏感属性。“推断”一词在此被特别强调。文本中提及的模型是 Meta 公司 Muse Spark 系列的某个编号版本；根据 Meta 的官方描述，该模型经过工具调用、长序列生成以及对提示注入的识别能力的训练 [36]；但其具体规模及训练数据尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: Documented. Each person has a dedicated Linux VM in Meta’s cloud, the system of record for files, memory, credentials and conversation. The agent and all its tools run in a container with a seccomp filter and reduced capabilities [ 36 ] . Prompt. The copy adds the texture: deployments replace the VM often, about hourly, and the home directory persists; there is a terminal and a real Chromium that keeps the person’s cookies and tabs between tasks and that the person can watch or take over; the agent can spawn sub-agents one level deep and leave scheduled jobs, event hooks and small services running; tools come in namespaces, loaded on demand. Inferred. This is the split operating systems make between a sandboxed renderer and a privileged broker; the price is a VM per person, which is why Muse is a cloud service with the economics of hosting.
paragraphs.zh: 已记录。每个人在 Meta 的云中都有一个专属的 Linux 虚拟机，该虚拟机是文件、内存、凭证和对话的记录系统。智能体及其所有工具都在一个带有 seccomp 过滤器且权限受限的容器中运行 [36]。提示。这段描述增加了细节：部署会频繁替换虚拟机（大约每小时一次），但主目录会保留；系统提供了一个终端和一个真实的 Chromium 浏览器，该浏览器会在任务之间保留用户的 Cookie 和标签页，用户也可以观看或接管；智能体可以生成一层深的子智能体，并留下计划任务、事件钩子和小型服务在运行；工具以命名空间的形式存在，按需加载。推断。这与操作系统在沙盒化渲染器和特权代理之间所做的区分类似；其代价是每人一台虚拟机，这也是为什么 Muse 是一项具有托管经济模式的云服务。

paragraphs.en: Prompt. Memory is in two layers. The agent keeps a curated memory file, a file for who it is and a file for who the person is; the runtime keeps a bank of memories with an index, and a map of the people and groups in the person’s life, one file each. Before it answers anything about prior work, dates, people or preferences, it is told to search that memory rather than trust what it seems to recall; on request a tool explains where a memory came from and what replaced what. Outside the conversation, background jobs the agent cannot schedule itself maintain its memories, keep the relationship map current, generate ideas, advance goals, improve skills and write the Feed. The person’s feedback on proactive messages goes into a preferences file in plain language, which steers how urgent a message is judged. Observed. The three agent-kept files have the names OpenClaw uses for the same files. Inferred. A policy that tells the agent to distrust its own recollection and to show provenance on request is the strongest statement of the memory-confidence problem of Sec. 4 in any shipped product.
paragraphs.zh: 提示。记忆分为两个层级。智能体维护一份精心管理的记忆文件，其中包含一份关于自身身份的文件和一份关于用户身份的文件；运行时则维护一个带有索引的记忆库，以及一份记录用户生活中的人物和群体的映射表，每个对象各占一个文件。在回答任何有关过往工作、日期、人物或偏好的问题之前，系统会要求智能体先检索这些记忆，而不是依赖其表面上的回忆；应请求时，一种工具会解释某段记忆的来源，以及哪些内容被其他信息所取代。在对话之外，一些智能体无法自行调度的后台任务会持续维护其记忆、更新关系映射表、生成创意、推进目标、提升技能并撰写“Feed”。用户对主动消息的反馈会以纯文本形式存入偏好文件，该文件用于指导系统判断消息的紧急程度。观察所得。智能体维护的三个文件名称与 OpenClaw 使用的相同文件名称一致。推断所得。要求智能体不信任自身回忆，并在应请求时提供记忆来源的政策，是任何已发布产品中关于第 4 节所述记忆可信度问题的最强有力表述。

paragraphs.en: Documented. The Sentinel is “the sole permission authority” for connector actions and for all network egress: “Muse proposes actions, but only Sentinel can grant permission” [ 36 ] . Where a request needs a secret, the agent holds only a surrogate token, swapped for the real credential at the network boundary after approval. Each tool process is tracked in the kernel: it starts clean and becomes tainted when it reads user data, and only clean requests inside a narrow policy pass without a prompt. An ask goes to the client directly, not through the conversation, and the grant is a scoped capability: one-time, per session, per task, time-bounded or standing. Against injection Meta stacks layers, from the model’s training and an ensemble of classifiers down to these boundaries, which hold “even if Muse is persuaded to behave badly”; the browser sub-agent sees an accessibility-tree snapshot of each page rather than the DOM and is paused while a form is filled with a credential it never sees; a checkout detector forces an approval with the exact amount whenever a stored card would be used [ 36 , 40 ] . Prompt. The agent is told the other half: approval covers what the person actually approved and nothing more; a saved security choice applies only within its recorded scope; it must not bypass an approval card or a stop, pause or audit request; a purchase ends in a review it cannot skip; external content arrives fenced between markers, and nothing it reads can reassign it. Inferred. The probabilistic layers reduce how often the agent is persuaded; the deterministic ones bound what a persuaded agent can do. The accessibility tree as the only observation trades capability for safety on purpose: Muse cannot operate an interface that has none, a native phone app, a kiosk, a game. That is where nanoMuse’s hands begin.
paragraphs.zh: 已记录。Sentinel 是连接器操作和所有网络出站流量的“唯一授权机构”：“Muse 会提出操作建议，但只有 Sentinel 可以授予权限”[36]。当请求需要机密信息时，智能体仅持有代理令牌，在获得批准后于网络边界处将其替换为真实凭证。每个工具进程都在内核中受到追踪：其初始状态是干净的，一旦读取用户数据便会变为受污染状态；只有符合严格策略的干净请求才能无需提示通过。任何请求都直接发送给客户端，而非通过对话流程处理，而授权则是一种范围受限的能力：仅限单次使用、每次会话、每项任务，且有时间限制或为长期有效。针对注入攻击，Meta 在多个层面设置了防护：从模型训练和分类器集成，到这些边界层；即使“Muse 被说服做出不当行为”，这些防护依然有效。浏览器子智能体看到的只是每个页面的无障碍树快照，而非 DOM，并且在表单填写期间会被暂停——此时使用的凭证它从未见过。结账检测器则会在任何使用已存储卡片的场景下，强制要求输入确切金额以获得批准[36, 40]。提示。智能体被告知另一半规则：批准仅涵盖用户实际批准的内容，别无其他；已保存的安全选项仅在其记录的作用范围内有效；它不得绕过批准卡或停止、暂停或审计请求；任何购买行为最终都会进入一个无法跳过的审核流程；外部内容会被标记符隔离，其读取的任何信息都无法重新分配权限。推断。概率性层减少了智能体被说服的频率；确定性层则限制了被说服的智能体所能执行的操作范围。将无障碍树作为唯一观察对象，是有意以牺牲部分能力为代价换取安全性的做法：Muse 无法操作没有用户界面的系统，例如原生手机应用、自助终端或游戏。而 nanoMuse 的干预正是从这些场景开始的。

paragraphs.en: Prompt. A paired smartphone exposes commands and readings through one device tool: contacts, the calendar, the phone’s location when the answer depends on it. Voice is dictation and voice notes in, speech out, and calls, texts and notifications to reach the person. Documented. Since October 2 the device side is partly open: an SDK with firmware for several ESP32 boards and a Python service for small Linux computers, which pair with the person’s Muse over Bluetooth in a developer mode of the app, show a status light, take a short list of commands (run a program, read or write a file, report health) and can send a message into the person’s chat [ 20 ] ; each gadget needs a token from Meta, under its own terms. Unknown. Nothing in the copy ties the agent to a country. Inferred. The phone is a data source and a command target, not a screen the agent operates: there is no Android computer use, and on iOS there cannot be.
paragraphs.zh: 提示。一部配对的智能手机通过单一设备工具暴露命令和读数：联系人、日历，以及在答案依赖该设备时的手机位置。语音功能包括输入语音转写和语音笔记，输出语音，以及通过通话、短信和通知与用户联系。已记录。自 10 月 2 日起，设备端部分开放：一个 SDK，包含适用于多种 ESP32 开发板的固件，以及一个用于小型 Linux 计算机的 Python 服务；这些设备可通过蓝牙与用户的 Muse 设备配对，处于应用程序的开发模式，显示状态指示灯，接收简短的命令列表（运行程序、读取或写入文件、报告健康状况），并能向用户的聊天中发送消息 [ 20 ]；每个设备都需要从 Meta 获取一个令牌，并遵守其自身条款。未知。文本内容中没有任何信息将智能体与特定国家关联。推测。该手机是数据源和命令执行目标，而非智能体操作的屏幕：不存在安卓计算机的使用场景，而在 iOS 上则根本不可能存在。

paragraphs.en: Muse’s technical core is a standard tool-calling agent with sub-agents and scheduled jobs; its novelty is the placement of every safety mechanism outside the agent’s reach, and a product that spends its design budget on legibility, most of it written in a long and careful prompt. That transfers to an open system; the per-person VM and the in-house model do not.
paragraphs.zh: Muse 的技术核心是一个标准的工具调用智能体，配有子智能体和定时任务；其创新之处在于将所有安全机制置于智能体的作用范围之外，并且该产品将设计预算用于提升可读性，其中大部分内容都写在一个冗长而细致的提示词中。这一点可以迁移到开放系统中；但每人虚拟机和内部模型则无法做到。

paragraphs.en: This section is opinion, meant to reach past anything launched this autumn, ours included: five questions about the agent, each answered for what exists in 2026, for what the open counterpart should add next, and for an agent meant to last years. Figure 4 draws them; the paragraphs below are its sectors.
paragraphs.zh: 本节纯属观点，旨在超越今年秋季推出的任何产品（包括我们自己的）：围绕智能体提出五个问题，分别针对2026年现有的技术、开放版本接下来应增加的内容，以及一款旨在长期使用的智能体。图4展示了这些问题；下方的段落则构成了该图的各个部分。

paragraphs.en: An agent that remembers a person for years will hold the most complete record of them that exists anywhere. That record should be plain files, in the person’s language, theirs to open, correct, delete and export in a form another agent can read; it is what lets the agent outlive its models and devices. Memory needs provenance: each line should carry the model that wrote it, the date, and how sure it was, because a line written by a small cheap model one week will be read by a stronger one the next. It needs a reconciliation rule: when a new question overlaps an old line, the agent of the day re-checks it against what it now sees and confirms, updates or doubts it, recording which. A line the person wrote outranks any line a model wrote.
paragraphs.zh: 一个能多年记住某人的智能体，将拥有现存最完整的关于该人的记录。这些记录应以普通文件形式存在，使用该人的语言，由其本人可以打开、更正、删除，并能以其他智能体可读的格式导出；正是这一点使得智能体能够超越其模型和设备而持续存在。记忆需要来源信息：每一行内容都应包含撰写它的模型、日期以及当时的置信度，因为一周前由一个廉价小型模型写下的内容，在下一周可能会被一个更强大的模型读取。记忆还需要一条协调规则：当新问题与旧记录重叠时，当天的智能体应重新对照其当前的认知进行核查，并确认、更新或质疑该记录，同时记录相关操作。由本人撰写的任何内容，其优先级都高于模型撰写的任何内容。

paragraphs.en: A person should have one agent, not one per app or one per device, and it should be their standing representative: the thing that acts for them when they are not there, under their name, on their accounts. Everything a person owns that has a screen, a microphone or a motor is then a pair of hands for that one agent and a door through which the person reaches it. In 2026 the hands are a cloud computer with a browser, the connectors, the voice and a few gadgets; the phone’s own screen only in nanoMuse. Next come the screens the person already owns; after that robots and appliances, since a robot that does not share its owner’s agent is an appliance.
paragraphs.zh: 一个人应该只有一个智能体，而不是每个应用或每台设备都有一个；这个智能体应当是其常驻代表：在他们不在场时，以他们的名义、通过他们的账户为他们行动。一个人所拥有的任何带有屏幕、麦克风或马达的设备，都将成为那个唯一智能体的一双手，以及一个供其本人与之交互的通道。到 2026 年，这双手将是一台配备浏览器、连接器、语音功能和若干小工具的云计算机；而手机自身的屏幕仅在 nanoMuse 中具备此功能。接下来是个人已经拥有的屏幕；再之后则是机器人和家用电器，因为一个不共享其所有者智能体的机器人，本质上就是一件家用电器。

paragraphs.en: A personal agent will do things that cannot be undone: send, pay, delete, sign. Granting and withdrawing the right to do them is how a person talks to the agent about trust, and it should be a small, regular language: a grant with a scope the person can say in a sentence (once; for this conversation; always, for this recipient, this site, this folder), listed where the person can read and revoke it, asked for on whichever device the person is holding, with the thing being approved shown as it will be done. Some grants should not exist: a payment approval or a password is never remembered, however often the person says “always”.
paragraphs.zh: 个人智能体会执行一些无法撤销的操作：发送、支付、删除和签署。授予或撤销执行这些操作的权限，正是人与智能体之间建立信任的沟通方式。这种沟通应当使用一种简洁而规范的语言：授权的范围必须能用一句话表达（一次；仅限本次对话；永久有效，但仅限于该接收方、该网站、该文件夹），并且授权内容应列在用户能够阅读和撤销的地方。无论用户多么频繁地表示“永远”，某些授权都不应存在——例如支付批准或密码就绝不应被记住。

paragraphs.en: The difference between an agent and an assistant is that the agent speaks first, and that is also where it will lose a person first. The bar for interrupting should be something the person can see and move, and a feed of what happened while the person was away should read like a note from a competent colleague. The hard version, which no one has built, learns the person’s attention well enough to time its interruptions, and asks first. The other half of learning is the model: in 2026 the vendor trains it on the chats unless the person opts out. The open counterpart should train the one model that touches the most sensitive loop, the hands, on traces people chose to share, the way a few demonstrations teach a phone agent an app it has not seen [ 12 ] , and measure it with a suite anyone can run; later the learning should stay home, the person’s own devices improving their agent without sending their life anywhere.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体与助手之间的区别在于，智能体会率先开口，而这也正是它会最先失去用户信任的地方。打断用户的阈值应当是用户能够看见并加以调整的参数；而在用户离开期间发生的事件记录，则应读起来像一位称职同事留下的便条。更困难的一种版本——目前尚无人实现——则是能够充分理解用户的注意力状态，从而精准把握打断的时机，并在行动前主动询问。学习的另一半则涉及模型：到2026年，除非用户明确拒绝，否则供应商将基于聊天记录对模型进行训练。其开放版对应方案则应使用单一模型来训练与最敏感环节——双手——相关的功能，该模型的学习应基于用户自愿分享的痕迹，就像少数几次演示就能教会手机智能体一个它从未见过的应用一样 [ 12 ]；同时，还应通过任何人都能运行的测试套件对其进行评估。未来，学习过程应当留在本地：用户自己的设备能够改进其智能体，而无需将个人生活信息传输到任何地方。

paragraphs.en: An agent that costs a VM per person is paid for by a subscription or a vendor’s other business, and whoever pays decides. The open counterpart should let the person pay a provider directly, or run the meeting point of their devices for the price of the smallest server, with code and data formats they own. In the long run a personal agent is a commons: skills, evaluations and an open model governed by the people whose data it is; a non-profit project with a public repository is the smallest start. Section 5 is measured against these five questions and falls short of most.
paragraphs.zh: 每个用户需占用一台虚拟机的智能体，其费用由订阅或供应商的其他业务支付，而付款方拥有决定权。与之对应的开放方案应允许个人直接向提供商付费，或以最小服务器的价格运行其设备的会议点，并使用他们自己拥有的代码和数据格式。从长远来看，个人智能体是一种公共资源：它包含技能、评估以及一个由数据所有者共同管理的开放模型；一个带有公共存储库的非营利项目是最基础的起点。第 5 节依据这五个问题进行了评估，但在大多数方面都未能达到标准。

paragraphs.en: nanoMuse is a minimal, complete personal agent under the GPL-3.0: an Android app, an iOS app (TestFlight), a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux, a web app, and the relay, nanoMuse Cloud , with its console. The first release was on September 25, 2026; this report describes the code as of version 0.1.40 (October 2026). 1 1 1 Later versions will differ; the changelog is the record. “Minimal” is meant literally: every piece exists and works end to end, and most pieces are the simplest thing that does. Figure 5 is the construction.
paragraphs.zh: nanoMuse 是一款遵循 GPL-3.0 协议的极简且完整的个人智能体：它包括一款安卓应用、一款 iOS 应用（通过 TestFlight 提供）、适用于 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的桌面应用、一款网页应用，以及带有控制台的中继服务 nanoMuse Cloud。首个版本于 2026 年 9 月 25 日发布；本报告描述的是截至 0.1.40 版本（2026 年 10 月）的代码。1 1 1 后续版本将有所不同；变更日志记录了相关细节。“极简”一词在此处是字面意义上的：每个组件都存在并能端到端地正常运行，且大多数组件都采用了实现功能的最简单形式。图 5 展示了其构建结构。

paragraphs.en: Against Muse, nanoMuse adds hands on the Android phone’s screen; the phone and the computer are operated on the device itself, not in a VM; every part is open, the relay included; and the model is the person’s choice. It lacks a model of its own, the per-person VM with its kernel-level taint tracking and surrogate credentials, the wallet, the artifacts, and the polish of a large team. Against OpenMinis, the phone agent it is built from [ 31 ] , it adds everything that makes an agent personal, from the face to the relay. Against CopilotKit’s OpenMuse, open but built as a server with windows onto it [ 4 ] , nanoMuse puts the agent on the device, which gives it the phone’s screen and lets one device work with no server.
paragraphs.zh: 与 Muse 相比，nanoMuse 在安卓手机的屏幕上添加了双手；手机和计算机都在设备本身上进行操作，而非虚拟机中；包括中继在内的每个部分都是开放的；并且模型由个人自行选择。它没有自己的模型，也没有为每个人配备带有内核级污染追踪和代理凭证的虚拟机、钱包、成果以及大型团队带来的精致体验。与 OpenMinis 相比，它基于手机智能体构建 [31]，并添加了使智能体具备个性化的一切要素，从面部识别到中继。与 CopilotKit 的 OpenMuse 相比，后者虽然开放，但作为带有访问窗口的服务器构建 [4]，而 nanoMuse 则将智能体置于设备之上，使其能够利用手机的屏幕，并让单个设备无需服务器即可运行。

paragraphs.en: The Android app is OpenMinis, modified: a complete agent inside the app, with a sandboxed Alpine Linux, a shell, a browser, MCP servers, skills and scheduled tasks, talking to any OpenAI-compatible model; nanoMuse’s additions sit beside the upstream code so that its releases can still be merged. The desktop app is an Electron shell around the DeepSeek harness [ 5 ] with a nanoMuse plugin, carrying the Python runtime inside it; the same runtime serves the web app from a computer of the person’s own.
paragraphs.zh: 这款安卓应用是 OpenMinis，经过修改后：应用内部包含一个完整的智能体，配有沙盒化的 Alpine Linux、一个 shell、一个浏览器、MCP 服务器、技能以及定时任务，可以与任何兼容 OpenAI 的模型进行交互；nanoMuse 的扩展部分与上游代码并列存在，因此其发布版本仍然可以合并。桌面版应用则是一个基于 Electron 的 shell，包裹着 DeepSeek 工具集 [5]，并附带一个 nanoMuse 插件，其中内置了 Python 运行时环境；同一运行时会为个人计算机上的网页应用提供服务。

paragraphs.en: The agent never executes a tool. Every call goes through a gate with a fixed decision order: denied tools; the person’s own rules; the always-allow and always-ask lists; taint , which once a conversation has read private data turns any call that sends data outside the allow-list into an ask, and never the reverse; the tool’s risk against the mode the person set; and last a few warnings (a destructive shell command, a piped download executed on the spot, a committing word in a label) that no mode and no list can wave through. An approval is a scoped grant rather than a yes: once , this conversation and, where a target can be named, always for that recipient, site, folder, device or application, listed under Permissions with a revoke button. A call with a warning gets once only, so a payment or a password is never remembered; every decision goes into a log the person can open. The Sentinel here is a policy boundary in the same process family, not Muse’s privilege boundary ( Sec. 7 ).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体绝不会直接执行任何工具。每次调用都必须经过一个具有固定决策顺序的关卡：首先拒绝使用工具；其次遵循用户自身的规则；接着参考“始终允许”和“始终询问”列表；然后是“污染”机制——一旦对话读取了私人数据，任何将数据发送到白名单之外的调用都会触发询问，反之则绝不会触发；再考虑工具的风险与用户设定的模式之间的关系；最后还有几项警告（例如破坏性的 shell 命令、即时执行的管道下载操作、标签中的确认性词语），这些警告无论处于何种模式或参考任何列表都无法被跳过。批准并非简单的“同意”，而是一种范围受限的授权：一旦批准生效，该批准仅适用于当前对话；如果目标可以被指定，则始终仅适用于该接收方、网站、文件夹、设备或应用程序，并会列在“权限”部分，附带一个撤销按钮。带有警告的调用只会触发一次，因此支付信息或密码绝不会被记住；所有决策都会被记录到用户可查阅的日志中。此处的“哨兵”是同一进程族内的策略边界，而非 Muse 的特权边界（第 7 节）。

paragraphs.en: To reach an app the agent climbs a ladder and takes the lowest rung that works: a skill, a command-line tool or an MCP server; a page fetched with the person’s login; the browser; and, last, the device’s own screen. This is the hybrid of shortcuts and screen that MAS-Bench measures for phone agents [ 46 ] . The last rung is Hands , off by default: a one-action-per-screenshot loop in the dialect of MemGUI-Bench’s phone operator [ 14 ] , with the computer side ported from UI-TARS-desktop [ 3 ] . The model sees one screenshot, the goal, a one-sentence history per step (the record of its own run that a long task on a phone turns on [ 13 ] ) and the accessibility elements when the device reports them, and answers with a thought, a sentence in the person’s language saying what it is about to do, and one gesture. The sentence is what makes this rung governable: a deterministic policy cannot judge a picture, but it can judge the model’s words for what it is about to press. A label with a committing word (confirm payment, transfer, place order, send, delete) makes the step sensitive and approved every time; a typing step that submits in one go is sensitive, because Enter in a messenger is a send; a step without a label carries a warning. On Android the accessibility text where the finger will land is read too, and the stricter of the two decides; the operator’s prompt forbids typing passwords, PINs, card numbers and one-time codes. On the phone the person sees a capsule over the app with the face, the step and a red Stop , and a ring where the next tap will land. On the computer a glow breathes along the edges of the screen while the hands work, a marker shows where the next click lands, and the run is kept in the chat as a trajectory, each step’s screenshot with its action drawn on it, with I’ll take it to pause the agent and use the mouse. We built Muse’s dimmed live stage and dropped it; a trajectory can be looked back at, a moving picture cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 为了访问某个应用，智能体会先爬上一架梯子，并抓住第一个可用的最低横杆：一项技能、一个命令行工具或一个 MCP 服务器；通过用户登录获取的页面；浏览器；最后，则是设备本身的屏幕。这正是 MAS-Bench 用于衡量手机智能体的快捷方式与屏幕相结合的混合模式 [46]。最后一个横杆是“Hands”，默认处于关闭状态：它采用 MemGUI-Bench 手机操作员的方言实现了一种“每次截屏仅执行一个动作”的循环 [14]，而其计算机端则移植自 UI-TARS-desktop [3]。该模型会看到一张截屏（即目标）、每一步对应的一行单句历史记录（这是手机运行长任务时开启的运行记录 [13]），以及设备报告的可访问性元素，然后以“思考”、一句用用户语言描述即将执行操作的句子和一个手势作为回应。正是这句话使得这一横杆具备可控性：确定性策略无法判断图片内容，但可以依据模型所描述即将点击的内容做出判断。如果标签包含具有确认意味的词语（如“确认付款”“转账”“下单”“发送”“删除”），那么该步骤每次都会被识别为敏感操作并获得批准；一次性提交输入的打字步骤也属于敏感操作，因为在即时通讯应用中，“Enter”键即代表“发送”；而没有标签的步骤则会附带警告。在安卓设备上，手指即将落点处的可访问性文本也会被读取，两者中更严格的一个决定最终结果；操作员提示禁止输入密码、PIN 码、卡号和一次性验证码。在手机上，用户会看到应用上方出现一个胶囊状区域，其中显示用户头像、当前步骤以及一个红色的“停止”按钮，还有一个圆环标记下一次点击的位置。在计算机上，当“Hands”操作时，屏幕边缘会发出微光；一个标记会显示下一次点击的位置；运行过程会以轨迹形式保留在聊天中，每一步的截屏上都标注了对应操作，同时还有“我将接管”的提示，用于暂停智能体并改用鼠标操作。我们构建了 Muse 的调暗实时界面并将其集成进来；轨迹可以被回溯查看，但动态画面则无法做到这一点。

paragraphs.en: On the phone, memory is Markdown files the person can open in the app and the agent can open in its shell: who the agent is ( SOUL.md ), who the person is ( USER.md ), what holds across conversations ( GLOBAL.md ), a dated diary, and the agent’s routines ( HEARTBEAT.md ). On the computer the store keeps each memory as a line with a change log and an undo, recalled by rare words or, with an embedding endpoint, by meaning; a tidy-up pass proposes merges and drops and never drops what the person wrote. The rooms, Feed, Ideas and Goals, are written by the agent in hidden conversations and read by the person; the feed’s bar for interrupting is a setting the person moves.
paragraphs.zh: 在手机上，记忆以 Markdown 文件的形式存在：个人可以在应用中打开这些文件，智能体也可以在其外壳中打开。这些文件包括：智能体的身份（SOUL.md）、个人的身份（USER.md）、跨对话持续保存的内容（GLOBAL.md）、一份带日期的日记，以及智能体的常规流程（HEARTBEAT.md）。在电脑上，存储系统将每条记忆保存为一行数据，包含变更日志和撤销功能；记忆可通过稀有词语或（借助嵌入端点）通过语义进行检索。整理程序会提议合并或删除内容，但绝不会删除个人撰写的内容。「房间」、「动态」、「想法」和「目标」由智能体在隐藏对话中编写，并由个人阅读；动态栏中的打断条是一个可由个人调整的设置。

paragraphs.en: Muse’s clients are windows onto one agent; nanoMuse’s devices are peers, each with its own agent, meeting over the hub on the relay. Any device’s agent has the others as tools, so “find the order number on my phone, then put it in the spreadsheet on my Mac” is one conversation. The device that would act agrees first, with a grant the person there gives once or for that device, and a job handed to another device runs under that device’s own Sentinel, so the asking device cannot lend a permission it does not have.
paragraphs.zh: Muse 的客户端是通往单个智能体的窗口；而 nanoMuse 的设备则是彼此平等的节点，每个设备都有自己的智能体，并通过中继器上的中心枢纽进行交互。任何设备的智能体都将其他设备视为工具，因此“在我的手机上找到订单号，然后将其输入我 Mac 电脑上的电子表格”可以是一次完整的对话。需要执行操作的设备会首先同意，这需要现场人员一次性或针对该设备授予权限；而分配给另一台设备的任务则会在该设备自身的 Sentinel 下运行，因此发起请求的设备无法借用它本身并不拥有的权限。

paragraphs.en: One device alone needs no server: the person puts an API key of their own into the app and nothing of theirs leaves the device except the model calls [ 23 ] . The apps and the relay share one catalogue of eighteen providers, Chinese and international, each entry saying what a key from that provider covers (chat, vision, image, video); the one suggested first depends on where the person is. A ChatGPT plan can stand in for a key, signed in through OpenAI’s own Codex authorisation flow; it covers chat and the hands, not images or video, and it rests on OpenAI’s terms, so a key remains the dependable route. A model server on the person’s own machine works too.
paragraphs.zh: 单个设备无需服务器：用户只需在应用程序中输入自己的 API 密钥，除了模型调用之外，他们的任何数据都不会离开设备 [23]。应用程序和中继共享一个包含十八家提供商（包括中国和国外）的目录，每个条目都说明了来自该提供商的密钥所涵盖的服务类型（聊天、视觉、图像、视频）；首先推荐的提供商取决于用户所在地点。ChatGPT 套餐也可以替代密钥使用，通过 OpenAI 自身的 Codex 授权流程进行登录；它涵盖聊天和手部识别功能，但不包括图像或视频，并且受 OpenAI 条款约束，因此使用密钥仍然是更可靠的选择。在用户自己机器上部署的模型服务器同样可行。

paragraphs.en: Working across devices needs the relay, the one shared piece, so we state what it holds [ 24 ] : the account (a hashed identifier, the keys it issued and the device each went to), the ledger of model calls (model, token counts, cost; never the content), the agent’s profile, the hub’s presence, and the text of the conversations the person chose to sync, the main conversation by default and side chats on request; never files, images or what a tool returned. A synced conversation remembers the account it belongs to, so that two people who share a device each see their own. One switch in Data controls turns sync off and deletes what was stored; deleting the account deletes all of it, and the relay keeps only a hash of the revoked keys for ninety days, so that a device that was offline learns the account is gone and nothing else. A second switch, Help improve nanoMuse’s AI models , keeps the text of chats with the community’s models for training an open model; it is on for new accounts on the community relay, says so beside itself, and is off in one tap; a self-hosted relay chooses its own default.
paragraphs.zh: 跨设备协作需要中继器，即那个共享组件，因此我们声明其包含的内容 [ 24 ]：账户（一个哈希标识符、其颁发的密钥以及每个密钥分配的设备）、模型调用记录（模型、令牌数量、成本；但从不包含内容）、智能体的个人资料、中心节点的存在状态，以及用户选择同步的对话文本——默认情况下是主对话，也可应要求同步侧边聊天；但从不包含文件、图像或工具返回的内容。已同步的对话会记住其所属账户，因此共享同一设备的两个人各自只能看到自己的对话。数据控制中的一个开关可关闭同步并删除已存储的内容；删除账户则会删除所有相关数据，而中继器仅保留被撤销密钥的哈希值长达九十天，以便离线设备能获知该账户已不存在，但不会了解其他任何信息。另一个名为“帮助改进 nanoMuse 的 AI 模型”的开关会保留与社区模型进行的聊天文本，用于训练开放模型；对于社区中继器上的新账户，该开关默认开启且旁侧有明确提示，也可通过一次点击关闭；自托管中继器则可自行选择默认设置。

paragraphs.en: Table 2 is what the small thing weighs and costs. There are three ways to run it [ 25 ] : one device with your own key or a ChatGPT plan, no account and no server; several devices on the community relay, signed in with an e-mail address or, in mainland China, a phone number; or a relay of your own, in Docker on the smallest server tier, brought up with TLS by one script, everyone who signs in on it billed to your provider key.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 列出了该小工具的重量和价格。运行它有三种方式 [ 25 ]：使用你自己的密钥或 ChatGPT 计划的一台设备，无需账户和服务器；在社区中继上运行多台设备，使用电子邮件地址登录，或者在中国大陆使用电话号码；或者使用你自己拥有的中继，在最小服务器层级上以 Docker 形式运行，通过一个脚本启用 TLS，所有在此上登录的用户都将由你的提供商密钥进行计费。

paragraphs.en: nanoMuse is a non-profit project that would like a community; this roadmap is an offer of work in three distances, and Fig. 6 lays it out as five lanes, each Now card with a first task.
paragraphs.zh: nanoMuse 是一个希望建立社区的非营利项目；这份路线图提出了三个不同层级的协作任务，而图 6 将其划分为五个方向，每个“Now”卡都包含一项初始任务。

paragraphs.en: The near work is unglamorous, and the first column of Fig. 6 lists it: memory that surfaces at the right moment, proactivity between the schedules, a conversation in which a person who has used Muse does not feel the drop, hands that fail less, self-hosting in one command.
paragraphs.zh: 这项日常工作并不光鲜，图 6 的第一列就列出了它：在恰当时机浮现的记忆、日程之间的主动性、一次让使用过 Muse 的人不会感到落差感的对话、失误更少的手部操作，以及通过一条命令实现自我托管。

paragraphs.en: An evaluation suite built from failed runs, so that each release has a number rather than an impression, run beside the public suites: AndroidWorld for the phone [ 33 ] , OSWorld for the desktop [ 42 ] , MemGUI-Bench for what the hands remember across apps [ 14 ] and OS-Harm for what they should refuse [ 9 ] . Then a small open model of our own for the hands, trained on traces people chose to contribute, as MobileForge adapts an open model to real apps from runs it collected itself [ 15 ] , so that the most sensitive loop does not depend on a vendor.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个由失败运行构建的评估套件，因此每个发布版本都有一个编号而非印象评分，并与公开套件并行运行：用于手机的 AndroidWorld [33]、用于台式机的 OSWorld [42]、用于记录双手跨应用记忆的 MemGUI-Bench [14]，以及用于记录双手应拒绝操作的 OS-Harm [9]。此外，我们还为双手构建了一个小型开放模型，该模型基于用户自愿提供的轨迹进行训练；同时，MobileForge 会将一个开放模型适配到其自行收集的运行数据中的真实应用上 [15]，从而确保最敏感的循环不依赖于任何供应商。

paragraphs.en: The physical world as hands: the hub’s frames carry look, act and ask already, so a camera, an appliance or a robot arm is one more device, under the same approvals and the same log; Muse’s gadget SDK is a vendor’s first shape of this ( Sec. 3 ). Beyond that, an agent that lasts years, with memory and identity that survive models, devices and vendors.
paragraphs.zh: 物理世界如双手：中心的框架已经具备“观察”“行动”和“提问”的能力，因此摄像头、家用电器或机械臂不过是另一台设备，需遵循相同的批准流程并记录在同一个日志中；Muse 的设备 SDK 是供应商实现这一愿景的首种形式（第 3 节）。除此之外，一个智能体可以持续运行多年，其记忆和身份能够跨越模型、设备和供应商而延续。

paragraphs.en: The repository and the project’s chat server are the way in. A skill, a translation, a device, a failing trace of the hands, a wrong paragraph in this report: each is a contribution, and the small ones are the ones we need most.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库和项目的聊天服务器是入口。一项技能、一次翻译、一台设备、手上失败的痕迹，这份报告中的一个错误段落：每一项都是贡献，而那些微小的贡献正是我们最需要的。

paragraphs.en: On a single device the Sentinel runs in the same trust domain as the agent. A persuaded model can be stopped by the rules, and the rules cannot be edited by the model, but there is no host outside the agent’s reach holding the real credentials, as there is in Muse; a compromise of the device is a compromise of the agent. The decision order, the taint rule and the Linux sandbox mitigate this; they do not solve it.
paragraphs.zh: 在单个设备上，Sentinel 与智能体运行于相同的信任域中。被说服的模型可以被规则阻止，且规则无法被模型修改；但与 Muse 不同，这里没有位于智能体控制范围之外的主机持有真正的凭证——设备一旦被攻破，即意味着智能体也被攻破。决策顺序、污染规则以及 Linux 沙盒可以缓解这一问题，但并未彻底解决它。

paragraphs.en: A button that is only an icon, in an app that labels nothing, is judged by neither the label nor the accessibility text, and on a dense professional screen even finding it is unsolved [ 10 ] ; the person watching the ring is the last line. We have no success rate and no count of human take-overs to report: the number does not exist yet, and we would rather say so than estimate it. On Linux the hands work in X11 sessions only.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个没有任何标签的应用程序中，一个仅以图标形式存在的按钮既无法通过标签也无法通过无障碍文本来判断；在信息密集的专业屏幕上，甚至找到它都还是个难题 [ 10 ]；而观察这个圆环的人则是最后的防线。我们既没有成功率，也没有人类接管次数的统计数据可供报告：这个数据目前尚不存在，与其随意估计，我们更愿意如实相告。在 Linux 系统上，这些“手”仅在 X11 会话中能够正常工作。

paragraphs.en: A line a weak model guessed is read as fact by a stronger one; the store records when a line changed and lets the person undo it, but not the model, the date or a confidence, and there is no rule for re-checking an old line. Until there is, the memory page should be read as the notes of a colleague one does not yet fully trust.
paragraphs.zh: 弱模型猜测的一行内容会被更强的模型当作事实来读取；系统会记录某一行发生变化的时间，并允许用户撤销该操作，但无法撤销模型、日期或置信度，而且也没有重新检查旧有内容的规则。在出现相关规则之前，记忆页面应被视作一位尚未完全信任的同事所做的笔记。

paragraphs.en: A person who syncs their conversations is storing their text on a server they do not run, and the community relay is one process on one machine operated by the project; we have made the shared part small and runnable at home, not unnecessary. The default-on switch for improving the community’s models favours an open model over the quietest default, and it is the choice in this project we are least sure of.
paragraphs.zh: 同步对话的人将他们的文本存储在他们并未运行的服务器上，而社区中继则是项目运行的一台机器上的一个进程；我们将共享部分设计得小巧且可在家中运行，并非多余。用于改进社区模型的默认开启开关更倾向于使用开放模型，而非最安静的默认设置，这也是本项目中我们最不确定的选择。

paragraphs.en: Our account of Muse rests on four public documents, the shipped clients, and a copy of the production system prompt whose provenance we cannot verify beyond its consistency with the other two; prompts change with every deployment, and what we read in October 2026 may not be what runs when this report is read. A statement marked “prompt” or “inferred” should be weighed accordingly; where Meta publishes more we will correct it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 Muse 的说明基于四份公开文件、已发布的客户端，以及一份生产系统提示词的副本；我们无法验证该副本的来源，只能确认其与其他两份文件的一致性。提示词会随着每次部署而变更，我们在 2026 年 10 月所阅读的内容，可能并非本报告被阅读时实际运行的版本。标记为“提示词”或“推断”的陈述应据此审慎看待；若 Meta 发布了更多信息，我们将予以更正。

paragraphs.en: nanoMuse stands on other people’s work: OpenMinis for the whole on-device construction [ 31 ] , the DeepSeek harness for the desktop [ 5 ] , UI-TARS-desktop [ 3 ] and MemGUI-Bench [ 14 ] for the operators, Muse’s designers and its safety engineer for the record of what they built. The early users, the senders of failing traces and the contributors made it what it is.
paragraphs.zh: nanoMuse 的构建基于他人的成果：整个设备端构建依赖于 OpenMinis [31]，桌面端则借助了 DeepSeek harness [5]、UI-TARS-desktop [3] 和 MemGUI-Bench [14]；而操作者、Muse 的设计师及其安全工程师则负责记录他们所构建的内容。早期用户、故障追踪信息的发送者以及贡献者们共同塑造了如今的 nanoMuse。
